cohort: Omental adipose tissue samples were collected from women during cesarean section of term pregnancy, categorized by nonoverweight (n=9), overweight (n=8), obese (n=10), and GDM (n=10) status.
finding: Increased macrophage infiltration and TNF-a expression in adipose tissue from GDM patients stimulate ADM and its receptor overexpression, leading to enhanced lipolysis and hyperlipidemia, potentially contributing to fetal macrosomia and adiposity.
cross-section timing: During cesarean section of term pregnancy
